fee_notes: Royalty Fee is tiered and service-type dependent. Mitigation Services royalty starts at 10% for first $0-$249,999.99 of cumulative annual Gross Receipts, stepping down to 9%, 8%, 7%, 6%, 5%, 4%, and 3% for $1,750,000+. Reconstruction Services royalty is a flat 3% of Gross Receipts. Minimum Royalty Fee (monthly): $400 (year 1), $1,000 (year 2), $1,500 (year 3), $2,500 (years 4-5), then prior year + CPI adjustment (years 6-20). Multi-Unit Program aggregates Gross Receipts across all locations with same tiered structure but wider brackets (starts at 10% for $0-$399,999.99, down to 3% for $2,800,000+). Conversion Franchisees receive time-limited royalty discounts (50% mitigation / 100% reconstruction in first 12 months, tapering to no discount by months 37-48). Marketing Fee is 2% of Gross Receipts, capped at $23,500 for 2026 per Franchise Business; certain franchisees in existence since at least 2004 are exempt. Local advertising requirement is also 2% of monthly Gross Receipts (separate from Marketing Fee). Tech fee of $525/month comprises DASH Software $500/month (Next Gear Solutions) plus Compliance Tracking Software $25/month (Profile Gorilla). Annual Convention registration fee is $695 ($595 early registration). Minimum Equipment and Supply Purchase requirement is 2% of Gross Receipts annually from designated suppliers.
